metric_note: Four-group failure-focused pilot. Word F1 and exact match measure agreement with Qwen, not ground-truth accuracy.

source_captions: A square throw pillow with a white background and green leaf pattern resting on the couch.
A seating couch with white pillows visible at the bottom-left of the room.
groups.baseline_caption: A white square throw pillow with a green leaf pattern resting on the couch.
groups.candidate_caption: A square white throw pillow with a green leaf pattern resting on a couch.

quality_review.notes: Faithfully consolidates the pillow and leaf pattern; it omits the white background detail.

source_captions: A desk set against the wall near the window, partially behind the sofa.
A white throw pillow on the sofa near the center.
groups.baseline_caption: A white throw pillow on the sofa near the center.
groups.candidate_caption: A desk set against the wall near the window, partially behind a sofa with a white throw pillow near its center.

quality_review.notes: Retains the desk but also folds in the sofa and pillow, which appear to be separate objects in the source captions.

source_captions: A small white ceramic vessel/cup with a dark interior, placed on the coffee table.
A flat magazine or book lying on a small tray on the coffee table.
groups.baseline_caption: A small white ceramic vessel with a dark interior on the coffee table, next to a flat magazine on a small tray.
groups.candidate_caption: A small white ceramic vessel with a dark interior and a flat magazine or book lying on a tray, both placed on the coffee table.

quality_review.notes: Combines the cup and magazine descriptions for one stored cup instance; the source captions appear to refer to different objects.

groups.baseline_caption: A square decorative pillow with a landscape and tree print on a pale blue base, placed on a white sofa.
